cards.title: One owner at a time
items: Embedded and standalone owners never run against one state
A stale feed stays visibly stale until recovery or rollback

cards.title: What moves
items: Identities, session/notice state, revisions and producer configuration
Pixoo’s facade reads the feed and sends labels and acknowledgments to the selected owner

cards.title: Recovery is explicit
items: A failed step leaves admission fenced and waits for the operator
Rollback targets a fresh store; embedded ownership is never restored into Pixoo’s old store
